source_remedy: Catch operation outcomes across the entire accepted handler, then close/wait its actual writer; post-upgrade IncompleteReadError remains the original expected disconnect category.

Stop the listener; retain optional driver failure and explicitly close/wait its acquired client transport. Driver shutdown precedes accepted peer shutdown to preserve existing no-fault reply behavior.
Close all recorded accepted writers and cancel only pending owned handlers before accepted joins. Observe every completed task and writer result, continuing after failures.
Retain completed failure objects and the original primary in RemoteFailures. Only actual cancellation requested by this shutdown is an expected task outcome.
Preserve the registry through fixture lifetime for exact unchanged control observations and backup re-observation. No new global registry, runtime framework or production API.
limits: No remedy native execution, suite, Cargo, broad gate, push or integration performed in this lane.
Per-stage ten-second wait_for bounds use cooperative actual fixture tasks. They do not establish a hard process-wide deadline against cancellation-resistant foreign code.
The existing 100ms control witness observes a finite before-backup state; is_closing is initiation, while explicit wait_closed observes completion.
Repeated external cancellation or process termination cannot promise fully awaited cleanup. No warning filter or disconnect-category widening was introduced.
